verdict.rationale: Square documents a Sandbox testing environment ([square-docs-13]) and in-person payment surfaces such as the Mobile Payments SDK, Tap to Pay and the Terminal API. However, the evidence is only a page title and never shows that the sandbox covers in-person flows end-to-end. missing for 10: evidence of a simulated reader or device, sandbox support for Terminal API or Mobile Payments SDK flows, test card values for in-person transactions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
